fields.statusText: Confirmed (2026-11-15 r3: R2 evidence met — second Tier-1 report Bloomberg 11/14 'SpaceX Catches Starship Rocket in Landmark Texas Landing' (Loren Grush, Spokesman-Review publication, text cross-checked: launch tower mechanical arm caught vehicle and stopped descent · Super Heavy catch attempt cancelled) + CNBC 11/14 · LL2 re-query update 2026-11-14 21:31:56 UTC (Ship success=true). AP 11/14 (cross-check): 22-hour flight · approximately 165 miles 14 orbits · Starlink 26 units · SpaceX 'overall vehicle including heat shield appears to have functioned well' · booster engines shut down too early during descent (SpaceX Kate Tice, under investigation). → R2 triggered · B-2027-1 Ship recovery 1 entry. FAA Flight 15 mishap investigation designation still 0 search results · SpaceX official flight summary unconfirmed (requirement-independent) / 2026-11-15 r2: result confirmed — LL2 status 'Launch Successful' · update 2026-11-14 21:23:58 UTC · 21:23 UTC update 'Starship Ship 42 has returned to Starbase.' · Ship landing success=true · booster landing success=false. CNBC 11/14 16:14 EST — launch tower mechanical arm first caught returning orbital upper stage (Tier-1). Space.com live — settled into arm at approximately 2120 GMT (⑥). SpaceX official flight summary unconfirmed · other Tier-1 reports catch article search 0 results → R2 determination pending (1/2 evidence).
